business_summary: AIR PRODUCTS AND CHEMICALS, INC. (NYSE: APD) supplies essential industrial gases and is a global supplier of hydrogen, including supply to Aramco's refinery and terminal complex under a 25-year agreement. It carries 1 chain/link placement: russian-diesel-ban/refinery-hydrogen (QUIET, not money_corner). Fundamentals this run: latest fiscal-year revenue 12,037,300,000, -1.77% 3-year revenue CAGR, -7.29% operating margin.

exposure_summary.narrative: Air Products has 1 placement: russian-diesel-ban/refinery-hydrogen, scored QUIET by the chain's own heat map (impact 45, crowdedness 30): the link's bottleneck note records that hydrogen cannot be moved far economically, so each refinery gate is a local monopoly held on a long-dated contract, a logistics constraint rather than a chemistry one. No chain-specific or link-specific revenue percentage is disclosed or sourced for this issuer; only company-wide fundamentals are available, and FY2025 carries a large operating loss (-877,000,000) that the 10-K period covers without a line-item cause captured in this fetch.
